Ui.Script:
-- ── Strings ── a 1.12 GlobalStrings global, or the fallback for a harness without them. function KeyBindings_String(name, fallback) local s = getglobal(name) if s then return s end return fallback end
-- ── Key display ── 1.12's GetBindingText in full form: modifier prefixes stay tokens, the -- base key reads its KEY_* global. "CTRL--" is CTRL plus the minus key. function KeyBindings_KeyText(key) if not key then return NORMAL_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. KeyBindings_String("NOT_BOUND", "Not Bound") .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE end local prefix = "" local rest = key while true do local p = string.sub(rest, 1, 4) if p == "ALT-" then prefix = prefix .. "ALT-" rest = string.sub(rest, 5) elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 5) == "CTRL-" then prefix = prefix .. "CTRL-" rest = string.sub(rest, 6) elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 6) == "SHIFT-" then prefix = prefix .. "SHIFT-" rest = string.sub(rest, 7) else break end end return prefix .. KeyBindings_String("KEY_" .. rest, rest) end
-- ── Page state ── `searchPainted` maps OptionsFrame.xml's search rows to binding indices. KeyBindingsPage = { sections = {}, items = {} }
KEYBINDINGS_ROW_BASE = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsRow" KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED = 19 KEYBINDINGS_ROW_HEIGHT = 25 KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS = 8
-- ── Section model ── one section per category in Bindings.xml order, collapsed at first -- as in the era; a rebuild keeps each state. function KeyBindings_BuildSections() local page = KeyBindingsPage local was = {} for _, s in ipairs(page.sections) do was[s.token] = s.expanded end page.sections = {} local byToken = {} for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do local _, category = GetBinding(i) local sec = byToken[category] if not sec then sec = { token = category, indices = {}, expanded = was[category] } byToken[category] = sec table.insert(page.sections, sec) end table.insert(sec.indices, i) end KeyBindings_Flatten() end
-- The visible list the faux scroll runs over. function KeyBindings_Flatten() local page = KeyBindingsPage page.items = {} for n, sec in ipairs(page.sections) do table.insert(page.items, { header = n }) if sec.expanded then for _, i in ipairs(sec.indices) do table.insert(page.items, { bind = i }) end end end end
-- A header click, voiced with the checkbox sound. function KeyBindings_ToggleSection(n) local sec = KeyBindingsPage.sections[n] if not sec then return end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") sec.expanded = not sec.expanded KeyBindings_Flatten() KeyBindingsPage_Update() end
-- Silent, for the capture fixture. function KeyBindings_ExpandSection(n, on) local sec = KeyBindingsPage.sections[n] if not sec then return end sec.expanded = on and true or false KeyBindings_Flatten() end
-- ── Painters ── shared by the list and the search rows, which capture in place. function KeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index) local command, _, key1, key2 = GetBinding(index) local b1 = getglobal(name .. "Key1Button") local b2 = getglobal(name .. "Key2Button") b1.commandName = command b2.commandName = command b1:SetText(KeyBindings_KeyText(key1)) b2:SetText(KeyBindings_KeyText(key2)) if key1 then b1:SetAlpha(1) else b1:SetAlpha(0.8) end if key2 then b2:SetAlpha(1) else b2:SetAlpha(0.8) end local desc = getglobal(name .. "Description") desc:SetText(KeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. command, command)) desc:Show() local page = KeyBindingsPage if page.selected == command and page.keyID == 1 then b1:LockHighlight() else b1:UnlockHighlight() end if page.selected == command and page.keyID == 2 then b2:LockHighlight() else b2:UnlockHighlight() end b1:Show() b2:Show() getglobal(name .. "Header"):Hide() end
function KeyBindings_PaintHeaderRow(name, n) local sec = KeyBindingsPage.sections[n] local header = getglobal(name .. "Header") header.sectionIndex = n header:SetText(KeyBindings_String(sec.token, sec.token)) local icon = getglobal(name .. "HeaderIcon") if sec.expanded then icon:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up") else icon:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up") end header:Show() getglobal(name .. "Description"):Hide() getglobal(name .. "Key1Button"):Hide() getglobal(name .. "Key2Button"):Hide() end
-- ── The list repaint (1.12 KeyBindingFrame_Update) ── function KeyBindingsPage_Update() local page = KeyBindingsPage local scroll = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsScrollFrame") local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scroll) for i = 1, KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED do local name = KEYBINDINGS_ROW_BASE .. i local row = getglobal(name) local item = page.items[offset + i] if item and item.header then KeyBindings_PaintHeaderRow(name, item.header) row:Show() elseif item then KeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, item.bind) row:Show() else row:Hide() end end FauxScrollFrame_Update(scroll, table.getn(page.items), KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED, KEYBINDINGS_ROW_HEIGHT) -- Our trough follows the bar `FauxScrollFrame_Update` has just shown or hidden. BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scroll:GetName()) KeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey() end
-- The page entry: a rebind or a set switch may have changed the table. function KeyBindingsPage_Refresh() KeyBindings_BuildSections() local box = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsCharacterRowCheck") if GetCurrentBindingSet() == 2 then box:SetChecked(1) else box:SetChecked(nil) end getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsScrollFrameScrollBar"):SetValue(0) KeyBindingsPage_Update() end
function KeyBindings_Output(text) getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsOutput"):SetText(text) end
-- ── Selection ── arms the host's capture, which hands its chord to KeyBindings_OnHostKey. function KeyBindings_SetSelected(command, keyID) KeyBindingsPage.selected = command KeyBindingsPage.keyID = keyID BenillaBindCapture(command ~= nil) end
function KeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey() local unbind = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind") if KeyBindingsPage.selected then unbind:Enable() else unbind:Disable() end end
-- Every search row: a bind from one can unbind a victim shown on another. function KeyBindings_RepaintVisible() if KeyBindingsPage.searchPainted then for name, index in pairs(KeyBindingsPage.searchPainted) do KeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index) end KeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey() else KeyBindingsPage_Update() end end
function KeyBindingButton_OnClick(button) -- As 1.12: while armed, a middle, 4 or 5 press is a bind the capture takes after this. local page = KeyBindingsPage if page.selected then if button ~= "LeftButton" and button ~= "RightButton" then return end if page.selected == this.commandName and page.keyID == this:GetID() then KeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) KeyBindings_Output("") else KeyBindings_SetSelected(this.commandName, this:GetID()) KeyBindings_Output(string.format( KeyBindings_String("BIND_KEY_TO_COMMAND", "Press Key to Bind to Command -> %s"), KeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. this.commandName, this.commandName))) end else KeyBindings_SetSelected(this.commandName, this:GetID()) KeyBindings_Output(string.format( KeyBindings_String("BIND_KEY_TO_COMMAND", "Press Key to Bind to Command -> %s"), KeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. this.commandName, this.commandName))) end KeyBindings_RepaintVisible() end
function KeyBindings_Commit() SaveBindings(GetCurrentBindingSet()) end
-- `chord` is ALT-CTRL-SHIFT-TOKEN; 1.12's OnKeyDown armed branch, then the live commit. function KeyBindings_OnHostKey(chord) local page = KeyBindingsPage if not page.selected then return end local selected = page.selected local oldAction = GetBindingAction(chord) if oldAction ~= "" and oldAction ~= selected then local k1, k2 = GetBindingKey(oldAction) if (not k1 or k1 == chord) and (not k2 or k2 == chord) then KeyBindings_Output(string.format( KeyBindings_String("KEY_UNBOUND_ERROR", "|cffff0000%s Function is Now Unbound!|r"), KeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. oldAction, oldAction))) else KeyBindings_Output(KeyBindings_String("KEY_BOUND", "Key Bound Successfully")) end else KeyBindings_Output(KeyBindings_String("KEY_BOUND", "Key Bound Successfully")) end local key1, key2 = GetBindingKey(selected) if key1 then SetBinding(key1) end if key2 then SetBinding(key2) end if page.keyID == 1 then KeyBindings_SetOrRestore(chord, selected, key1) if key2 then SetBinding(key2, selected) end else if key1 then SetBinding(key1, selected) end KeyBindings_SetOrRestore(chord, selected, key2) end KeyBindings_Commit() KeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) KeyBindings_RepaintVisible() end
-- 1.12's KeyBindingFrame_SetBinding, message and all; SetBinding refuses only a non-key. function KeyBindings_SetOrRestore(key, command, oldKey) if not SetBinding(key, command) then if oldKey then SetBinding(oldKey, command) end KeyBindings_Output(KeyBindings_String( "KEYBINDINGFRAME_MOUSEWHEEL_ERROR", "Can't bind mousewheel to actions with up and down states")) end end
-- 1.12's Unbind Key body, then the live commit. function KeyBindings_Unbind() local page = KeyBindingsPage local key1, key2 = GetBindingKey(page.selected) if key1 then SetBinding(key1) end if key2 then SetBinding(key2) end if key1 and page.keyID == 1 then if key2 then SetBinding(key2, page.selected) end else if key1 then SetBinding(key1, page.selected) end end KeyBindings_Commit() KeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) KeyBindings_Output("") KeyBindings_RepaintVisible() end
-- ── Character-specific set ── checking saves set 2 at once (LoadBindings(2) falls back -- to the account set); unchecking confirms first, as the era does. The accept loads set 1 -- before saving it, or the character binds would be written into the account set. function KeyBindings_CharacterToggle(box) PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") if box:GetChecked() then LoadBindings(2) SaveBindings(2) KeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) KeyBindings_Output("") KeyBindingsPage_Refresh() else box:SetChecked(1) StaticPopup_Show("CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS") end end
StaticPopupDialogs["CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS"] = { text = KeyBindings_String("CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS", "Really switch to general key bindings? All key bindings specific to this character will be permanantly deleted."), button1 = KeyBindings_String("OKAY", "Okay"), button2 = KeyBindings_String("CANCEL", "Cancel"), OnAccept = function() LoadBindings(1) SaveBindings(1) KeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) KeyBindings_Output("") KeyBindingsPage_Refresh() end, } -- Reset To Default confirms, as the era's does; our string, since 1.12 has none. StaticPopupDialogs["CONFIRM_RESET_KEYBINDINGS"] = { text = "Are you sure you want to reset all keybindings to their defaults?", button1 = KeyBindings_String("OKAY", "Okay"), button2 = KeyBindings_String("CANCEL", "Cancel"), OnAccept = function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") LoadBindings(0) KeyBindings_Commit() KeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) KeyBindings_Output("") KeyBindingsPage_Refresh() end, }
-- ── Search ── a binding's tag is its display name uppercased, as the era's. -- A static pool of KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS rows, where the era's results scroll. function KeyBindings_SearchMatches(words) local out = {} for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do local command = GetBinding(i) local tag = string.upper(KeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. command, command)) local s = OptionsSearch_Score(tag, words) if s then table.insert(out, { score = s, index = i }) end end return out end
